design: All80 competent H840 task pairs bidirectional. Final-position block-state donor swaps at all18 layers. At layers1/2 also equal-length-only positional whole-sequence, token-differing positions, token-identical positions, and complete dynamic state (residual sequence + persistent L0 value bus + x0) donor swaps.
alignment: Sequence intervention only exact equal token lengths; mask from indexwise token inequality. No semantic alignment claim. Unequal pairs retained for final-position sweep, excluded and listed only for sequence swaps.
controls: Final-block swap must reproduce donor logits. Complete dynamic-state early swap must reproduce donor logits. Native runner agrees with established runner. Identity final-position swap at every depth on one batch.
scope: Reused exploratory panel. Residual-only interventions retain recipient x0 and persistent value bus; complete-state arm changes both. Last-layer transfer is architectural positive control, not localized discovery.
next: Use depth and position results to choose causal sites for representation validation; do not identify a feature solely by reconstruction or final-layer transfer.
